scientific.integrity: The vector field and the source formulas were checked against the open-access article; algebraic identities were independently replayed with exact rational arithmetic. Literature searches found no covering correction, with ordinary residual search risk retained.
scientific.limitations: The theorem concerns exact divergence, phase-volume contraction, and compact ergodic invariant-measure Lyapunov sums. It does not establish existence or boundedness of an attractor, hyperchaos, synchronization, or encryption performance.

title: Sharp phase-volume contraction boundary for a hyperbolic-sine four-dimensional flow
